findings.title: Add regression tests for the Secretariat data allowlists
findings.body: The role-specific application and donor projections protect income, evidence, CPF, address, and receipt metadata at the database boundary, but the test suite never calls either action as Secretaria or asserts its `columns`/nested-student allowlists. A future broad query or a newly added sensitive field would reach the Secretaria payload while all current tests pass.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:64-79 and :131-150 contain the new security-critical explicit projections → Path: a maintenance change removes `columns` or adds a sensitive column to either Secretaria branch → Verdict: applicant financial/evidence data or donor CPF/receipt data becomes client-delivered without a failing-capable test.
__tests__/admin-actions.test.ts:150-186 calls getApplications only through the default Administrator mock and has no getDonorPledges coverage.
__tests__/solicitacoes-client.test.tsx imports SolicitacoesClient, not SecretariatApplicationsClient; the restricted client path is not rendered by a test.

findings.title: Protect the Secretariat final-document ID authorization path with a test
findings.body: The new persisted-ID download action is the boundary that prevents Secretaria from downloading a prior version or an ineligible contract, but no test invokes `getIssuedDocumentUrl`. The only role test calls `getCurrentIssuedDocuments` directly, so removing the current-ID comparison from the URL action would leak an older or ineligible final document while the suite still passes.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:828-837 authorizes a guessed issued-document ID for Secretaria by comparing it with the current, status-eligible IDs → Path: a Secretaria caller submits an old decision ID or a contract ID belonging to a rejected application → Verdict: deleting or weakening lines 831-833 produces a sensitive-document disclosure that no existing test exercises.
__tests__/admin-actions.test.ts:193-207 tests only getCurrentIssuedDocuments and getIssuedDocumentHistory; getIssuedDocumentUrl is not imported or called there.
rg -n "getIssuedDocumentUrl" __tests__ → the only other references are client mocks, not an action-boundary assertion.

findings.title: Movimentação pós-commit ainda sobrescreve anexos homônimos
findings.body: Premise: `createUploadUrl` isola cada upload em `pending/{uuid}/{category}/{filename}` e os campos de IR e extrato bancário aceitam múltiplos anexos, mas `moveFilesToApplication` em `form-actions.ts:349-355` descarta o UUID e move todos eles para `applications/{appId}/{category}/{filename}`. → Path: uma família envia dois arquivos da mesma categoria e com o mesmo nome; ambos passam pela validação e ganham linhas de documento distintas, mas o segundo `storage.move` substitui o primeiro no destino POSIX. → Verdict: a solicitação persistida referencia duas evidências, embora uma tenha sido perdida e ambas possam apontar para o último arquivo. Preserve o UUID de cada upload (ou gere um destino unívoco) ao promover arquivos após o commit e cubra nomes repetidos.
evidence: Premise: app/form/_components/step-3-income.tsx:98-105 e step-4-expenses.tsx:85-94 permitem múltiplos arquivos, enquanto form-actions.ts:349-355 remove o UUID do destino. → Path: dois anexos homônimos da mesma categoria chegam a applications/{appId}/{category}/{filename}. → Verdict: o segundo move sobrescreve o primeiro e as duas linhas de documentos podem apontar para o arquivo remanescente.

app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts:99-108 cria caminhos isolados em pending/{uuid}/{category}/{filename}, enquanto app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts:349-355 remove o UUID ao formar applications/{appId}/{category}/{filename}.
lib/storage/index.ts:60-65 implementa move com rename, que substitui um destino existente no filesystem.

findings.title: Cover the donor-first route and landing-page contract
findings.body: The public-route and donor-first hierarchy changes have no dedicated tests: the only canonical-route test exercises the scholarship page’s open/closed state. Reintroducing an old public URL, changing either legacy redirect, restoring the administrative quick link, or reversing the donor/scholarship DOM order would all pass the current suite.
evidence: Premise: Task 04 requires exact direct 308 redirects, canonical links, donor-first navigation/hero/quick-access/content order, contact replacement, and shared seal semantics → Path: any of those landing/route regressions is introduced in app/page.tsx, app/form/page.tsx, or app/benfeitor/page.tsx → Verdict: the production public journey regresses with no failing-capable coverage.

__tests__/form-page.test.tsx:19-50 imports only app/solicitar-bolsa/page and asserts its active-school-year rendering; it does not inspect redirects, landing links, donor page, email, quick access, or seal semantics.
rg -n "seja-um-benfeitor|solicitar-bolsa|contato@arcaprovidencia" __tests__ → only the canonical scholarship-page import appears, with no public-experience regression suite.

findings.title: A rota canônica abandona o layout completo do formulário
findings.body: Premise: a rota legada agora redireciona diretamente para `/solicitar-bolsa`, mas a nova página renderiza apenas uma faixa curta de cabeçalho; o layout completo com volta à página principal, introdução institucional e o mesmo `SealLogo` continua exclusivamente em `app/form/layout.tsx:13-103`, que não envolve a rota canônica. → Path: todo visitante que seguia `/form` passa pelo 308 e chega à implementação nova sem esse layout público existente. → Verdict: a migração de rota altera a experiência do formulário e deixa uma superfície executável de layout divergente, contrariando o contrato de reutilizar o fluxo/layout atual na página canônica. Mova/reutilize o layout em `/solicitar-bolsa` (ou extraia-o para um componente compartilhado) e deixe a rota legada somente como redirect.
evidence: Premise: app/form/page.tsx:1-5 redireciona todo acesso legado para /solicitar-bolsa, mas app/solicitar-bolsa/page.tsx:14-16 não usa o layout existente. → Path: visitantes da URL legada chegam somente à árvore curta da rota canônica. → Verdict: elementos públicos que antes envolviam o formulário deixam de ser renderizados após a migração.
app/solicitar-bolsa/page.tsx:14-16 renderiza somente um header compacto e o conteúdo dinâmico.
app/form/layout.tsx:13-103 contém o contêiner, link de retorno, apresentação institucional e seção de texto que não são alcançados pela rota canônica.

advisories.title: Align the issued-document action names with the implemented surface
advisories.body: The action table calls the issuance operations `issueDecision` and `issueContract`, but the task specification and implementation expose the persisted operations as `exportDecision` and `exportContract`. Using the actual names in this contract prevents a future maintainer from looking for nonexistent actions or introducing duplicate wrappers.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_techspec.md:407-408 names `issueDecision` and `issueContract` → Improvement: one action vocabulary makes the technical contract searchable and unambiguous → Fix: rename those two table entries to `exportDecision` and `exportContract`, retaining their described issuance behavior.
.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_03.md:52 → the task explicitly identifies the existing `exportDecision` and `exportContract` actions as the issuance surface to evolve.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:491,741 → the exported server-action symbols are `exportDecision` and `exportContract`; no `issueDecision` or `issueContract` action exists.

advisories.title: Synchronize the task records with the delivered work
advisories.body: Tasks 02–05 still declare `status: pending` and leave every subtask unchecked, although their corresponding implementation and test changes are present in this same review. This makes the delivery tracker unable to distinguish unfinished acceptance work from completed work awaiting the final gate.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_02.md:2 and lines 38-44 retain `pending` and seven unchecked subtasks → Improvement: the workflow record accurately communicates completed scope and remaining verification → Fix: after the final acceptance check, mark each fulfilled subtask and task 02 status as completed, then apply the same update to tasks 03–05.
.compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/task_03.md:2, task_04.md:2, task_05.md:2 → all three related implementation tasks retain the same pending status.

app/admin/_actions/staff-actions.ts, lib/documents/issued-documents.ts, app/solicitar-bolsa/page.tsx, and app/form/_actions/form-actions.ts → the corresponding task implementation surfaces exist in the reviewed worktree.

advisories.title: Cover nested parent-document requirements independently
advisories.body: The new parameterized test covers only top-level document groups. It does not prove that `pai.documentos` and `mae.documentos` reject an empty array independently, so a future relaxation of either required parent upload can pass this focused required-upload suite unnoticed.
evidence: Premise: __tests__/application-schema.test.ts:154-160 enumerates declaracao_vaga, certidao_casamento, comprovante_endereco, extrato_ir, and extratos_bancarios only → Improvement: every required parent upload gains an explicit regression boundary → Fix: add empty-array cases for pai.documentos and mae.documentos using their nested paths.
lib/validations/application-schema.ts:74-88 → both nested parent document arrays use requiredFileArray and belong to the mandatory upload contract.

advisories.title: Name the administrator-only guard after its actual scope
advisories.body: `requireAuth` now always delegates to `requireAdmin`, although the name still reads as a generic authenticated-staff guard. Rename it (for example, `requireAdminSession`) or call `requireAdmin` directly so future actions do not accidentally use it when a Secretaria capability is intended.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:43-45 exposes a helper named requireAuth that unconditionally calls requireAdmin → Improvement: makes the role boundary visible at every call site → Fix: rename the helper and its call sites, or inline requireAdmin.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:53-152 → the same module separately uses requireCapability for the explicit Secretaria-readable operations, so the two guard scopes need distinguishable names.

advisories.title: Avoid shadowing the DOM Document type
advisories.body: The local `Document` alias shadows the standard DOM `Document` type in a client component. Rename it to `IssuedDocument` to make its domain meaning explicit and avoid ambiguous type references while this component grows.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_components/issued-documents.tsx:6 declares the issued-PDF record as `type Document` → Improvement: removes ambiguity with the DOM global from the client-side type namespace → Fix: rename the alias and its two state declarations to `IssuedDocument`.
app/admin/_components/issued-documents.tsx:8-9 → both state collections use this local record type exclusively, so the rename is bounded to this module.

advisories.title: Keep section access metadata separate from its display title
advisories.body: The Secretaria filter identifies the configuration section by the literal Portuguese title. This couples access control to copy: renaming or translating that heading would expose the section in the menu. Add an `adminOnly` flag to the section metadata and filter that flag instead.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/_components/sidebar.tsx:191-193 hides settings through `section.title === "Configurações"` → Improvement: prevents a presentation-only title edit from changing menu authorization behavior → Fix: model the restriction as a boolean on the section object and check that boolean.
app/admin/_components/sidebar.tsx:35-40 → item-level administrator access is already modeled as metadata (`adminOnly`), which is the reusable pattern for the section.

advisories.title: Use one import declaration for the client module
advisories.body: The page imports from `./client` twice. Combining the default component, Secretariat component, and type into one declaration keeps the module dependency in one place and makes future exports easier to spot.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/benfeitores/page.tsx:2 and :5 both import from `./client` → Improvement: a single declaration makes the page's client dependency surface clearer → Fix: merge the imports into one declaration.
app/admin/benfeitores/page.tsx:20-24 → all three imports are consumed by the same role branch in this module.

advisories.title: Derive secretariat state types from the actions
advisories.body: The new card declares abbreviated payload shapes locally, then casts both Server Action results to those shapes. Derive the state types from the actions (or export shared DTOs) and assign the values without assertions, so a projection change becomes a TypeScript error at this consumer.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/client.tsx:103-109 manually declares action-result shapes and uses `as typeof notes` / `as typeof documents` → Improvement: projection changes become compiler-visible at the client boundary → Fix: use `Awaited<ReturnType<typeof action>>` state types or exported DTOs and remove the casts.
app/admin/_actions/observation-actions.ts:7-15 → the observations action independently owns its projection.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:getCurrentIssuedDocuments → the issued-document projection is independently owned by that action.

advisories.title: Preserve role-specific application result types
advisories.body: The page erases the role-specific projection returned by `getApplications` with unchecked casts, including one through `unknown`. Return a discriminated role/result union (or separate role-specific read actions) and narrow it before rendering so selected-column changes cannot silently reach the wrong client shape.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/solicitacoes/page.tsx:20-22 casts the same value to `SecretariatApplicationSummary[]` and through `unknown` to `ApplicationSummary[]` → Improvement: maintain compile-time checking of the permission-limited projections → Fix: model the action response as a discriminated union keyed by role, or split the reads.
app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:61-90 → the action deliberately selects different column sets for secretaria and admin.

advisories.title: Split staff-management flows into readable units
advisories.body: The complete create, activate/deactivate, reset-password, and render flows are encoded in four source lines. Reflow the handlers and JSX (optionally extracting a user-row component) so asynchronous state/error branches can be reviewed, changed, and tested independently.
evidence: Premise: app/admin/usuarios/client.tsx:13-16 contains all mutation control flow and both rendered sections in single physical lines → Improvement: future state and accessibility changes gain meaningful line-level review and blame → Fix: split handlers and JSX into conventional multi-line units.
package.json:5-18 → no Prettier dependency or formatting script owns this maintainability change.

advisories.title: Formatar as árvores JSX das novas páginas públicas
advisories.body: A página inteira é retornada em uma única linha. Estruturar o JSX em linhas e blocos aninhados torna alterações futuras nos dados bancários, no formulário e na hierarquia semântica revisáveis sem alterar o comportamento.
evidence: Premise: app/seja-um-benfeitor/page.tsx:12 contém toda a árvore de retorno em uma linha → Improvement: blocos JSX legíveis permitem revisar e editar cada seção independentemente → Fix: reformatar o retorno em elementos e props em múltiplas linhas, sem mudar a estrutura.
app/solicitar-bolsa/page.tsx:16 → o mesmo padrão de retorno em linha única aparece na outra página pública adicionada.

advisories.title: Revisar a redação atualizada dos requisitos da secretaria
advisories.body: O requisito recém-adicionado contém erros de concordância e capitalização (por exemplo, “observaçÕes” e “a os documentos”), o que reduz a clareza do documento que orienta a manutenção dessa matriz de acesso.
advisories.suggestion: A secretaria poderá acessar e ver os nomes e os dados dos benfeitores. Poderá incluir observações e consultar somente o resultado — se a solicitação foi aceita ou não —, o contato de referência dos pais e a escola. Também terá acesso aos documentos finais gerados para enviar aos pais. Não poderá aprovar ou rejeitar uma solicitação.
evidence: Premise: docs/changes/2026-07-27.md:17 registra o novo escopo com “observaçÕes”, “a os documentos” e frases elípticas → Improvement: texto gramaticalmente claro reduz ambiguidade na consulta futura do requisito → Fix: substituir o parágrafo pela redação autocontida sugerida.
docs/changes/2026-07-27.md:12 → a frase de escopo do administrador no mesmo documento também usa “todos as funcionalidades”, confirmando que a edição necessita de uma revisão textual localizada.

suppressions.candidate: Application-level FOR UPDATE serializes versions per kind
suppressions.note: The application row lock serializes every final-document issuance for one application; the unique application/kind/version index remains a database backstop.

suppressions.candidate: Current-document lookup may expose prior versions
suppressions.note: listCurrentIssuedDocuments orders by version and keeps the first item per kind; the Secretariat URL action separately requires that exact current ID.

suppressions.candidate: Pending upload paths could carry arbitrary categories
suppressions.note: The server allowlists ticket categories and validateDocumentCategories binds each submitted path to its exact required category before any database read or write.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat UI could reach full application detail
suppressions.note: The Secretariat branch renders its own card and only calls observations/current-issued-document actions; full detail remains guarded by requireAdmin.

suppressions.candidate: Marriage certificate database label differs from ticket category
suppressions.note: The transport path is intentionally validated as certidao while persistence keeps the pre-existing domain label certidao_casamento; the database category is not an authorization handle and no caller depends on path/category equality after the validated submission.

suppressions.candidate: Documentation-only Go capability struct in a TypeScript application
suppressions.note: The surrounding text explicitly identifies the struct as workflow-template compliance only and says it introduces no Go runtime component.

suppressions.candidate: Inactive-account fixture does not set a role
suppressions.note: The login branch rejects the inactive account before role authorization, so the minimal fixture specifically verifies the intended generic-credential response and no-session behavior.

suppressions.candidate: Compact single-line issued-document test setup
suppressions.note: Line wrapping is formatter-owned and does not create a distinct maintainability improvement beyond the configured formatting surface.

suppressions.candidate: Inline fragment formatting in the detail panel
suppressions.note: The candidate concerns line wrapping only; no separate bounded maintenance benefit was established beyond formatting.

suppressions.candidate: Environment stubs are not explicitly restored in this file
suppressions.note: The affected test is last in its describe block and no concrete cross-test failure was established from the inspected suite configuration.

suppressions.candidate: No UI error state for issued-document loading
suppressions.note: An error presentation could be desirable, but the review did not establish a project requirement or a concrete maintainability benefit beyond general preference.

suppressions.candidate: Decompose the category/path validation regular expression
suppressions.note: The small allowlist and escaped category validator have one focused responsibility; no concrete improvement beyond subjective reformulation survived.

suppressions.candidate: Extract the repeated attached-file predicate
suppressions.note: The predicate only appears in the removal guard and its matching disabled state, so extraction provides no measurable local maintenance benefit.

suppressions.candidate: Use a distinct inactive-account login message
suppressions.note: The inactive check returns the existing generic invalid-credentials message, preserving account-enumeration resistance.

suppressions.candidate: Add replacement behavior for removed disabled uploader branch
suppressions.note: The assigned old-side hunk removes the disabled branch; the resulting required uploader remains fully interactive.

suppressions.candidate: Trocar a tag img do selo por next/image
suppressions.note: O ativo é um SVG local com dimensões explícitas; não há benefício concreto demonstrado de otimização de imagem para esta mudança.

suppressions.candidate: Remover size do selo hero porque o CSS define suas dimensões
suppressions.note: O atributo mantém dimensões intrínsecas e não há falha ou ambiguidade operacional concreta; não justifica um comentário separado.

suppressions.candidate: Reescrever o comentário de preservação de decisões
suppressions.note: A migração não modifica decisões existentes e o comentário não cria ambiguidade executável ou de manutenção suficiente para um resultado.

suppressions.candidate: Hand-refactor generated Drizzle snapshot metadata
suppressions.note: The snapshot is Drizzle-generated migration metadata; its role, observation, and issued-document definitions are derived from the migration/schema and are not a hand-maintainable refactor target.

suppressions.candidate: Hand-refactor generated Drizzle snapshot metadata
suppressions.note: The snapshot is Drizzle-generated migration metadata derived from the schema and migration, so it is not a hand-maintainable refactor target.

suppressions.candidate: Reformat the Drizzle migration journal entry
suppressions.note: The journal entry is generated migration bookkeeping and correctly registers migration index 6 and its tag.

suppressions.candidate: Retain the disabled-upload feature flag for later reuse
suppressions.note: The implementation contract explicitly removes this temporary flag and makes enabled uploads the only supported behavior.

suppressions.candidate: Optimize the embedded raster payload in the executable seal asset
suppressions.note: The implementation contract requires a copy of the approved seal-arca-master.svg; changing its embedded payload would break the required master-asset fidelity.

suppressions.candidate: A stale session could retain access after the account is deactivated or its role changes.
suppressions.note: requireStaff resolves the session only to identify the row, then fetches id, email, role, and ativo from admin_users for every protected call; missing and inactive rows are rejected before capability dispatch.

suppressions.candidate: The Secretariat application list could deliver finance or applicant-evidence data by using a broad query.
suppressions.note: The Secretariat branch uses explicit application and student column allowlists at the database boundary, before the client receives the list.

suppressions.candidate: The Secretariat donor list could deliver CPF, address, CEP, or receipt metadata.
suppressions.note: The role-specific donor query selects operational fields only and omits CPF, address, CEP, receipt path, and receipt name at query time.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretariat caller could obtain an applicant-evidence ticket by submitting a known storage path.
suppressions.note: getDocumentUrl is still behind requireAuth, whose implementation resolves requireAdmin, while the only Secretariat final-document route is the separate persisted-ID action.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretariat user could download an old final-document version or a contract for a rejected application by guessing an ID.
suppressions.note: The action resolves the ID server-side and, for Secretaria, compares it to getCurrentIssuedDocuments. That lookup suppresses all pending documents and contracts for rejected applications, and returns only the latest version per kind.

suppressions.candidate: An anonymous caller could mint an upload ticket with traversal, arbitrary category, or dot-segment path.
suppressions.note: Categories are a fixed allowlist plus tightly indexed student patterns; filenames are sanitized and reject dot segments; the signed path is generated server-side under a fresh pending/{uuid} namespace. The storage driver independently enforces root containment.

suppressions.candidate: An uploaded HTML filename might execute in an Administrator browser when downloaded.
suppressions.note: guessMimeType returns application/octet-stream for every non-PDF/image extension, and the preview control is rendered only for database rows labeled application/pdf. An HTML payload named .pdf is delivered as application/pdf and does not create a browser HTML execution path.

suppressions.candidate: The role rollout could invalidate legacy staff identities or references during migration.
suppressions.note: The migration adds role while nullable, gives ativo a true default, backfills every legacy null role to admin, then adds the check and only afterward sets role NOT NULL. It neither recreates admin_users nor changes applications.decided_by, so existing IDs, password hashes, and decisions remain valid.

suppressions.candidate: New observation and issued-document rows could be orphaned or permit invalid version identity after rollout.
suppressions.note: Both new tables require their application and staff foreign keys; application deletion cascades while referenced staff deletion is restricted. issued_documents has positive-value and kind checks plus the unique application/kind/version index and latest-version index. The generated 0006 snapshot models those same constraints and indexes.

suppressions.candidate: The migration may not be ordered after the deployed schema state.
suppressions.note: The journal registers 0006 at sequential index 6 after 0005. Its DDL is additive except for the compatibility-preserving admin_users columns and constraints, with no drop, rename, or table recreation.

suppressions.candidate: Version allocation lacks test coverage
suppressions.note: The focused unit test asserts the version increment, immutable metadata, and storage cleanup; the surviving gap is the public authorization handoff, reported separately.

suppressions.candidate: Upload-category allowlist lacks failing-capable coverage
suppressions.note: form-actions.test.ts covers every fixed category, indexed student categories, traversal/separator/unknown rejection, ticket scope, sanitization, and UUID isolation.

suppressions.candidate: A projeção administrativa completa poderia alcançar o cliente da Secretaria.
suppressions.note: A ramificação de Secretaria seleciona explicitamente somente os campos operacionais da aplicação e id/nome dos alunos antes de entregar o resultado ao cliente específico do papel.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretaria poderia obter uma versão histórica ou contrato inelegível por ID.
suppressions.note: Para Secretaria, getIssuedDocumentUrl revalida o ID contra getCurrentIssuedDocuments, que exclui pendentes, contratos de rejeitadas e versões que não sejam a mais recente.

suppressions.candidate: As categorias emitidas no cliente e aceitas no servidor poderiam divergir.
suppressions.note: Os componentes emitem rg_aluno_{i} e certidao_nascimento_{i}; validateDocumentCategories exige exatamente esses padrões, além das categorias gerais allowlisted.

suppressions.candidate: Concurrent final-document reissues could duplicate a version
suppressions.note: The metadata transaction locks the application row before reading the latest version, and the migration enforces unique (application_id, kind, version). This meets TechSpec §Final Documents issuance rules.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat application query could expose restricted family data
suppressions.note: The secretaria branch uses a server-side allowlist for only the specified application, parent-contact, decision-date, and student identity fields; it does not fetch the complete application row.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat could download an unissued, historical, or ineligible final document
suppressions.note: Downloads accept a persisted issued-document ID, resolve storage_path server-side, and the secretaria path compares that ID with the current status-eligible document set. History remains guarded by requireAdmin.

suppressions.candidate: Direct scholarship submission could bypass required document categories
suppressions.note: The unconditional Zod requirements execute before school-year lookup and validateDocumentCategories separately verifies every fixed and indexed student category below a pending UUID path.

suppressions.candidate: Donor-first public ordering or legacy route transition could violate the public contract
suppressions.note: Navigation, hero, content bands, and quick access put the canonical benefactor route before scholarship; legacy route pages are direct permanent redirects and the canonical scholarship page retains force-dynamic.

suppressions.candidate: The executable seal might differ from the approved Open Design master or lack semantic modes
suppressions.note: public/seal-arca.svg byte-matches docs/design/opendesign/assets/seal-arca-master.svg; SealLogo forwards caller size/class and uses empty alt plus aria-hidden only for decorative use.
